en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town with vineyards or gardens in the foreground, dense residential blocks in the middle, and prominent historic church towers and other multi‑storey buildings rising above the roofs. Hills and fields stretch across the distant background. In the lower left corner, white text is printed directly on the image, identifying the place.
